source.captured_from: BOOT partition /dev/sda14 (live device readback) and the running userspace captured 2026-10-30 while the phone was running the PWNAGE-37000/38000 fixes; this release publishes those exact bytes
source.repository_head: the commit named by the annotated v0.2.1 tag (created by the release workflow from the merged main commit)
source.carried_forward_from: v0.7.3-beta: this release updates documentation and launcher overlays only; the captured BOOT/userspace bytes are unchanged from the verified 2026-10-30 handset capture

installed_boot_image.content: the complete live BOOT partition read back from /dev/sda14 on the phone; a complete, flashable boot image
installed_boot_image.note: captured 2026-10-30 from the running handset after the PWNAGE-38000 splash/audio fixes; the full partition and the shipped image are the same bytes

installed_userspace_manifest.note: live capture from the running phone on 2026-10-30; includes the PWNAGE-37000/38000 deployed userspace. It is a hash inventory, not a rootfs block snapshot.

ci_built_image.note: The workflow rebuilds the current repository sources for this release and publishes that archive next to these captured live bytes. It is NOT byte-identical to the installed image; the captured image above is the exact handset image and is carried forward unchanged from the verified v0.7.3-beta capture.

rootfs.note: The root filesystem is a live, mounted read-write ext4 filesystem. A consistent block-device snapshot needs an owner-approved freeze/remount; this release therefore does not present a live rootfs copy as an exact installed image. It ships the exact installed BOOT image and a hash inventory of the installed userspace files instead.

provenance.trimmed_image_read: not applicable: the shipped image is the complete BOOT partition, not a trimmed prefix
provenance.workflow_note: The CI image builder produces a source rebuild for the current repository; the release workflow also publishes the captured installed image and labels both explicitly.
provenance.verification: gzip integrity, decompressed size/SHA-256, ANDROID! v1 header, page size, raw arm64 Image, kernel/ramdisk hashes and the full-partition readback hash were verified locally before commit.

installed_boot_partition.note: The complete BOOT partition is shipped; no stale trailing bytes are omitted.
